title: Harness 即语言：极简主义 Agent 框架的最大表达力
summary: 论文提出 JAZ 框架，将 LLM 调用抽象为语言原语 invoke，仅靠 agent loop 本身实现记忆与自我改进等复杂工作流。在 StuLife 长程回忆任务上比 Letta(MemGPT) 高 8% 且成本减半，在 AppWorld 持续自我改进上比 ACE 高 4% 且成本更低。
summary_en: The paper introduces JAZ, a minimalist LLM agent framework treating the LLM call as a language primitive 'invoke'. With only prompting and no external tools or memory systems, JAZ invoke outperforms Letta (MemGPT) by 8% at half the cost on StuLife's recall-heavy portion, and beats ACE by 4% at lower cost on AppWorld continual self-improvement.
